purpose: 0 ≠ nothing. 0 = ecological niche waiting to be filled. Trace the absence.

jellyfish.character: Amorphous, floating, no rigid structure. Reactive not proactive.
jellyfish.what_would_fill_it: A feed that's alive but shapeless — raw event streams, unstructured logs, real-time sensor data before processing. The PRINTER'S noise IS jellyfish data: alive, oscillating, structureless.
jellyfish.why_zero: All our feeds have been intentionally structured (JSON with keys). We haven't captured raw unprocessed signal yet.
jellyfish.what_it_solves: Sometimes you need to SEE the raw signal before structuring it. A jellyfish feed would be: printer heartbeat pulses, WiFi signal strength over time, raw mDNS broadcast stream, unfiltered syslog.
jellyfish.example: Pipe the printer's status every 30 seconds → raw JSON array → that's a jellyfish. No structure. Just alive.

flatworm.character: Simple, minimal, bilateral symmetry. The FIRST organism with a head (cephalization). Regenerates from fragments.
flatworm.what_would_fill_it: A feed with very low information density — a config file, a simple key-value store, a binary yes/no health check. The SIMPLEST useful signal.
flatworm.why_zero: Every feed we made has been information-rich. We skipped the simple ones. But sometimes the flatworm IS the answer.
flatworm.what_it_solves: When a vertebrate is overkill. A health check doesn't need 5KB of JSON. It needs: alive=true, ts=now. That's a flatworm. Flatworm vs roundworm: the flatworm is flat (2D, simple, regenerates) vs roundworm (cylindrical, tube-within-tube, one-way gut). The roundworm invented the one-way digestive tract — input≠output. The flatworm has ONE opening — input=output, mouth=anus. That's a Klein surface!

prion.character: Not even alive by most definitions. A misfolded protein that forces other proteins to misfold. Contagious structure. Information as disease.
prion.what_would_fill_it: A feed so simple it's just a repeated pattern — a heartbeat with no variation, a constant, a hash. Pure signal, zero information beyond 'I exist and I'm this shape.'
prion.why_zero: Nothing we produce is that minimal. But a BLAKE3 hash IS a prion: 64 hex chars, fixed structure, conveys identity through shape alone.
prion.what_it_solves: Identity verification. A prion doesn't carry a message — it carries a SHAPE. The shape IS the message. Like a BLAKE3 signature: the hash doesn't tell you what's in the document, it tells you the document IS ITSELF.

roundworm.note: NOT IN OUR TAXONOMY YET — but should be!
roundworm.character: Tube-within-tube body plan. The FIRST organism with separate input and output (mouth ≠ anus). One-way digestion. C. elegans has exactly 302 neurons — the most mapped nervous system in biology.
roundworm.what_it_solves: Pipeline architecture. Input → process → output. No backflow. The roundworm IS a Unix pipe. stdin → process → stdout. The flatworm has one opening (bidirectional, Klein). The roundworm has two (unidirectional, pipeline).

vs_flatworm.flatworm: One opening. Input=output. Bidirectional. Klein surface. Simple. Regenerates.
vs_flatworm.roundworm: Two openings. Input≠output. Unidirectional. Pipeline. 302 neurons. Mapped.
vs_flatworm.when_flatworm: When you need simplicity, regeneration, or the fold (scan→print on same device = flatworm)
vs_flatworm.when_roundworm: When you need pipeline (scan→sign→relay→print = roundworm, one-way gut)
vs_flatworm.key_insight: The sovereign-fax pipeline IS a roundworm. The ET-2400 copy function IS a flatworm. Same device, two body plans depending on use.
